:::{#def-complement}
#### Complement

Let $A$ be a [subset](#def-subset) of a set $S$.
The **complement**
[@wikipedia_complement_set_theory]
of $A$ in $S$
is the set difference (@def-set-difference) $S \setminus A$:
the elements of $S$ that are not in $A$.
When the set $S$ is clear from context,
the complement of $A$ is written $A^c$:

$$A^c \eqdef S \setminus A = \set{x \in S : x \notin A}$$

:::
